I didn't like that this brush was so small (It is tough to keep a grip while using it.) and that the lettering faded leaving streaks on my hand and counter (This isn't a big deal.).  If you have thin hair this will be great for you I just suggest that you take the  lettering off before using. If you have thick hair you'll just have to work a little bit longer but it still does a great job.

claims.text: Reviewers widely report the brush detangles effectively, including on fine, thick, curly, and kinky hair, often without needing detangling spray or wetting the hair first.
Many parents say the brush is painless and reduces tears and complaints when brushing their children's hair.
Some reviewers note the bristles are sharp or rough and can scratch or redden the scalp.
A few reviewers mention the brush can still pull or break hair despite claims otherwise.
Reviewers appreciate the brush's size and ergonomic shape, finding it easy for both adults and children to hold and use.
